naslov: EuroCup roundup: Napoli and Hapoel remain unbeaten, huge victories for Bahcesehir and Aris
tekst:
By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
Bahcesehir continued with their excellent performances, this time defeating Lietkabelis 99-61 on their home court.
Bahcesehir maintained the lead throughout the game, but they were particularly impressive in the third quarter, which they dominated 31-9.
Malachi Flynn was the top scorer for the home team with 15 points, while Aleksa Avramovic contributed 13 points and six assists, Trevion Williams added 13 points and nine rebounds, Mateusz Ponitka scored 12, and Kenan Sipahi had 11 points. For the visitors, Keondre Kennedy and Alexander Schumacher each scored 11 points.
Tenerife secured a victory in the seventh round by defeating Siauliai 86-71 on the road, in their first game after the departure of Marcelinho Huertas.
The visitors won all four quarters in Lithuania and were led to victory by TJ Bamba, Vince Hunter, and Giorgi Shermadini, each scoring 13 points. For the home team, Cedric Henderson was the most efficient with 12 points.
Napoli still unbeaten, convincing victories for Aris and Hapoel
Basket Napoli remains undefeated in the EuroCup, as they defeated Chemnitz 112-90 on the road, marking their seventh triumph.
The Italians won the second quarter 35-19, paving their way to victory, led by Jeff Dowtin with 20 points and seven assists, while Jahmi’us Ramsey had 19, and Zach Seljaas 18. On the other side, Cobe Williams scored 21 points.
Aris achieved another victory, winning in Thessaloniki 105-81 against Rigas Zelli.
Aris scored 63 points in the first half, setting a club record for points in a EuroCup half.
Adam Mokoka and Matt Morgan each scored 19 points for the home team, while Tony Perkins led the visitors with 16 points and Tyler Wahl added 12.
Alongside Napoli, the only other team with a perfect record is Hapoel Jerusalem, who defeated Tortona 91-77 on the road.
Kenneth Lofton led the visitors to victory with 17 points, reaching this after winning the last quarter by 17 points. Devontae Cacok and Shake Milton each had 14. On the other side, Dante Maddox and Giordano Bortolani scored 15 each.
